title_i18n.zh: 超越一刀切：面向多模态大模型视觉令牌剪枝的样本自适应策略路由
title_i18n.en: Beyond One-Size-Fits-All: Sample-Adaptive Strategy Routing for Vision Token Pruning in MLLMs

summary_i18n.zh: 该研究指出固定视觉令牌剪枝策略在不同样本上存在互补性，平均最优策略并非对每个样本都最优。作者提出VIP-Router，一种轻量级视觉剪枝路由器，依据低成本视觉与文本特征为每个输入自适应选择预测最合适的剪枝策略，并在剪枝不利时保留全令牌推理选项。

items.why_it_matters: 多模态大模型推理成本高昂，视觉令牌剪枝是重要加速手段，但固定策略忽略样本差异。该工作以极低参数开销实现即插即用的样本自适应路由，为在不修改底层剪枝算法与模型权重的前提下提升剪枝效果提供了可借鉴思路。
items.problem: 在给定剪枝率下，能否根据每个输入样本的特征动态选择最合适的视觉令牌剪枝策略，从而在平均准确率与考虑实际令牌成本后的效用上超越任何单一固定策略。
items.novelty: 摘要报告该工作通过分析揭示不同剪枝策略在样本层面存在显著互补性，并提出以低成本视觉与文本特征为条件、可保留全令牌推理选项的轻量路由器，且以即插即用方式工作，不修改底层剪枝算法或模型权重。

evidence.claim_zh: 在精心构建的剪枝敏感视觉感知基准VTC-Bench Group A上，VIP-Router在所有压缩率下均持续优于最佳固定策略基线，平均准确率相对提升26.9%，计入实际令牌成本后的平均效用相对提升22.0%。
evidence.quote: Evaluated on a curated suite of pruning-sensitive visual perception benchmarks, VTC-Bench Group A, VIP-Router consistently outperforms the best fixed strategy baseline across all reduction ratios, achieving a 26.9% relative improvement in average accuracy, and a 22.0% relative increase in average utility after accounting for realized token cost.
evidence.conditions_zh: 条件为VTC-Bench Group A基准、多种压缩率、与最佳固定策略基线比较；摘要未说明具体基准子任务、样本数量、压缩率取值列表以及效用函数的具体定义。

evidence.claim_zh: VIP-Router以即插即用方式运行，不修改底层剪枝算法或模型权重，引入的可训练参数量仅相当于骨干网络的0.017%。
evidence.quote: Crucially, VIP-Router operates in a plug-and-play manner without modifying underlying pruning algorithms or model weights, introducing trainable parameters equivalent to merely 0.017\% of the backbone.
evidence.conditions_zh: 条件为不修改底层剪枝算法与模型权重、参数量以骨干网络为参照；摘要未说明骨干网络的具体规模、路由器参数量绝对值以及训练路由器所需的数据与计算成本。

evidence.claim_zh: VIP-Router在多种多模态大模型骨干上均有效，并在未见过的基准上取得一致增益，显示出样本自适应路由用于视觉令牌剪枝的潜力。
evidence.quote: Furthermore, VIP-Router proves effective across various MLLM backbones and yields consistent gains on unseen benchmarks, highlighting the potential of sample adaptive routing for visual token pruning.
evidence.conditions_zh: 条件为多种多模态大模型骨干与未见基准；摘要未说明具体骨干名称、未见基准的构成以及增益的统计显著性与方差。

items.limitations: 摘要未说明路由器的训练数据规模、训练目标细节、推理延迟开销以及在不同剪枝率下的最坏情况表现。摘要也未说明在真实部署环境中与固定策略相比的端到端吞吐收益，这些仍待全文确认。
items.borrow_experiment: 可尝试在自有视觉感知基准上，固定同一组候选剪枝策略与剪枝率，将是否启用样本自适应路由作为变化变量，以平均最优固定策略和全令牌推理为对照，观察平均准确率、考虑实际令牌成本后的效用以及路由器引入的额外参数量与推理延迟。

source.title: Beyond One-Size-Fits-All: Sample-Adaptive Strategy Routing for Vision Token Pruning in MLLMs
source.abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) process hundreds or thousands of visual tokens per image, incurring prohibitive inference costs. While existing vision token pruning methods mitigate this overhead, they implicitly assume that a single fixed pruning strategy can be applied uniformly across all inputs. Our analysis further reveals that ranking pruning methods by average benchmark accuracy conceals substantial sample-wise complementarity: although the average-best strategy excels overall, alternative strategies prove superior on a significant fraction of individual samples. To harness this diversity, we propose VIP-Router, a lightweight VIsion Pruning Router that adaptively selects the pruning strategy predicted to be best suited to each input at a specified pruning level. Conditioned on low-cost visual and textual features, VIP-Router identifies the most suitable candidate strategy while retaining full-token inference as an option when pruning is predicted to be unfavorable. Evaluated on a curated suite of pruning-sensitive visual perception benchmarks, VTC-Bench Group A, VIP-Router consistently outperforms the best fixed strategy baseline across all reduction ratios, achieving a 26.9% relative improvement in average accuracy, and a 22.0% relative increase in average utility after accounting for realized token cost. Crucially, VIP-Router operates in a plug-and-play manner without modifying underlying pruning algorithms or model weights, introducing trainable parameters equivalent to merely 0.017\% of the backbone. Furthermore, VIP-Router proves effective across various MLLM backbones and yields consistent gains on unseen benchmarks, highlighting the potential of sample adaptive routing for visual token pruning.

title_i18n.zh: 把主动学习与剪枝合并：同一训练循环能否得到稀疏子网络？
title_i18n.en: One Loop, Two Gains: Can Active Learning win the Lottery for Free?

summary_i18n.zh: 该研究观察到基于池的主动学习与迭代幅度剪枝都依赖反复从头重训练，计算结构高度相似。作者提出Improve & Prune方法，将幅度剪枝嵌入主动学习的每轮重训练循环中，几乎不增加额外成本，并实证检验在主动学习非平稳数据机制下能否产生中奖彩票。

items.why_it_matters: 深度主动学习因每轮重训练与未标注池评分而难以在大模型和大池上落地。若剪枝能作为主动学习流程的副产品免费获得稀疏可部署模型，则有望同时缓解两个计算瓶颈，对主动学习的实际采用具有直接价值。
items.problem: 在主动学习所特有的非平稳数据机制下，迭代幅度剪枝能否像在标准静态训练中那样产生中奖彩票，即稀疏子网络在孤立训练时匹配稠密网络准确率，并且这种稀疏化能否在每轮主动学习迭代中同时降低重训练与采集评分的成本。
items.novelty: 摘要将主动学习的迭代重训练循环与迭代幅度剪枝的计算结构对应起来，提出在每轮主动学习重训练中集成幅度剪枝的Improve & Prune方法，并在多种采集函数、架构族与图像分类数据集以及主动微调场景中检验其能否产生中奖彩票。

evidence.claim_zh: 结果表明Improve & Prune在每个主动学习迭代中都能产生稀疏可部署模型，这些模型在稀疏度高达95%时仍匹配其稠密对应模型的准确率，实际上作为主动学习流程的副产品获得了中奖彩票。
evidence.quote: Our results demonstrate that I&P yields sparse, deployable models at each active learning iteration. Those match the accuracy of their dense counterparts at sparsities up to 95%, effectively obtaining winning tickets as a byproduct of the active learning pipeline.
evidence.conditions_zh: 条件为多种采集函数、多种架构族、多个图像分类数据集以及主动微调场景，稀疏度最高达95%；摘要未说明具体数据集名称、架构规模、采集函数列表以及准确率匹配的判定阈值。

evidence.claim_zh: 这些每轮稀疏模型可以缓解当前阻碍深度主动学习在大架构和大未标注池上实际采用的两个计算瓶颈，即每轮模型重训练与未标注池上的采集评分。
evidence.quote: These per-iteration sparse models can address two computational bottlenecks - per-round model retraining and acquisition scoring over the unlabeled pool - that currently prevent the practical adoption of DAL on large architectures and large unlabeled pools.
evidence.conditions_zh: 条件为深度主动学习在大架构与大未标注池场景；摘要未说明瓶颈缓解的量化幅度、实际墙钟时间加速比以及是否在真实大规模池上验证。

items.limitations: 摘要未说明剪枝调度、稀疏度增长方式与具体超参数设置，也未报告在更大规模架构或更大未标注池上的实际加速比。摘要未说明主动微调场景的具体设定与结果细节，这些仍待全文确认。
items.borrow_experiment: 建议在自有图像分类数据集上，固定主动学习采集函数与轮次预算，将是否在每轮重训练中集成幅度剪枝作为变化变量，以标准主动学习稠密重训练为对照，观察每轮稀疏模型与稠密模型的准确率差距、达到目标准确率所需标注量以及重训练与采集评分的实际耗时。

source.title: One Loop, Two Gains: Can Active Learning win the Lottery for Free?
source.abstract: The lottery ticket hypothesis posits the existence of winning tickets: sparse subnetworks that, when trained in isolation from their original initialization, match the accuracy of the full dense network. The predominant method for discovering such tickets, iterative magnitude pruning, alternates pruning with full retraining from scratch until convergence over many cycles. Similarly, deep active learning also retrains a model from scratch after each acquisition round as new labels become available. Despite this shared reliance on iterative retraining with a substantial computational overhead, the two paradigms have been studied separately. We observe that the iterative training loop inherent to pool-based active learning already provides the exact computational structure that iterative magnitude pruning exploits, and propose Improve & Prune (I&P), a method that integrates magnitude pruning into each active learning retraining cycle at practically no additional cost. This raises a key empirical question: can iterative magnitude pruning produce winning tickets under the non-stationary data regime of active learning? We investigate this question across multiple acquisition functions, architecture families, and image classification datasets, including an active fine-tuning scenario. Our results demonstrate that I&P yields sparse, deployable models at each active learning iteration. Those match the accuracy of their dense counterparts at sparsities up to 95%, effectively obtaining winning tickets as a byproduct of the active learning pipeline. These per-iteration sparse models can address two computational bottlenecks - per-round model retraining and acquisition scoring over the unlabeled pool - that currently prevent the practical adoption of DAL on large architectures and large unlabeled pools.
